title: 03_qc pipeline parameters
description: Three independent genotype-concordance validation studies for the dog10k mapping pipeline: HighPass-vs-LowPass, Axiom-vs-LowPass, and a downsampling study. Reuses reference files and several processes from 01_mapping.

reference_genome.title: Reference genome
reference_genome.description: Same UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0 reference files used by 01_mapping.

assembly_ref.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA (UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0_ROSY.fa).
assembly_ref.help_text: Associated index files (.fai, .dict) must be co-located in the same directory as this FASTA.

known_variants.help_text: A tabix-indexed BED.gz file. The .tbi index must exist at ${known_variants}.tbi.

chunks_dir.description: Directory containing BED files that split the genome into processing chunks (chunks_10/).
chunks_dir.help_text: Same chunk set used by 01_mapping's mapping/BQSR/gVCF step, reused here for re-mapping downsampled BAMs.

glimpse_imputation.title: GLIMPSE imputation
glimpse_imputation.description: Same Dog10K phased reference panel used by 01_mapping, needed to re-impute the downsampled BAMs.

highpass_cohort.title: HighPass cohort inputs
highpass_cohort.description: Outputs of 01_mapping's HighPass track, consumed by studies 1 and 3.

highpass_snp_vcf.description: Jointly-called, hard-filtered HighPass SNP VCF (published by 01_mapping as highpass/snp_vcf/SNP.HF.ann.id.vcf.gz).

highpass_bam_dir.description: Directory of per-sample HighPass BAMs (published by 01_mapping as highpass/bam/).
highpass_bam_dir.help_text: Expected filenames: <sample_id>.sorted.merged.MarkDups.BQSR.bam(.bai). Only used by the downsampling study (study 3).

lowpass_cohort.title: LowPass cohort inputs
lowpass_cohort.description: Output of 01_mapping's LowPass track, consumed by studies 1 and 2.

lowpass_qc_vcf_dir.description: Directory of per-chromosome, QC-filtered LowPass VCFs (published by 01_mapping as lowpass/vcf/).

axiom_cohort.title: Axiom-array cohort input
axiom_cohort.description: Output of 02_data_processing's Axiom liftover/imputation stage, consumed by study 2.

axiom_lowpass_vcf_dir.help_text: 02_data_processing/2_Axiom_imputation's published vcf/ output (QC_AND_CONVERT_CHR's per-chr DA_AFFYimp_<chr>.qc.modi.vcf.gz) — run that pipeline first.

sample_lists_and_pairs.title: Sample lists and concordance pair samplesheets
sample_lists_and_pairs.description: Fixed sample lists and call/truth sample-pair tables driving the three concordance studies.

samples_highpass_11.description: One SRR accession per line: the 11 HighPass dogs also sequenced LowPass (study 1).

samples_downsampling_10.description: One SRR accession per line: the 10 HighPass dogs included in the downsampling study.
samples_downsampling_10.help_text: Deliberately 10, not 11 — SRR13340529 was excluded from the original analysis. See the stage README for provenance.

downsample_p_at_1x.description: CSV of sample_id,p_at_1x — the per-sample Picard DownsampleSam probability at 1x target coverage.

concordance_highpass_lowpass_pairs.description: CSV of pair_id,call_sample,truth_sample for study 1 (call_sample = LowPass SRR, truth_sample = HighPass SRR).

concordance_axiom_lowpass_pairs.description: CSV of pair_id,call_sample,truth_sample for study 2 (call_sample = LowPass SRR, truth_sample = Axiom sample ID).
